purpose: Map GW008 Season 1 honor competition names to existing Results sm_action and competition_key and inspect Trophy Room columns
sql: SELECT sm_action, competition_group, competition_key, sm_country, sm_division, COUNT(*) AS n FROM `GW008_IMC Results` WHERE game_world_id='GW008' AND match_date BETWEEN '2026-03-30' AND '2026-08-29' GROUP BY sm_action,competition_group,competition_key,sm_country,sm_division ORDER BY competition_group,sm_action,sm_country,sm_division
